findings.title: Daily diary fallback evidence and counter are not persisted
findings.suggestedFix: Propagate sanitized fallback_report through the diary upsert, distinguish provider fallback, and increment daily_diaries_fallback from the persisted result.

findings.title: Read-time scan recovery is not durably written
findings.suggestedFix: Persist the reconciled active array and last_recovered_operation atomically during Core reconciliation.

findings.title: owner_instance_id is per-operation and weakly validated, not a process-start UUID
findings.suggestedFix: Create one UUID at process start, reuse it for all scan operations, and validate the persisted value as a UUID.

findings.title: The Taipei date contract is not shared by all default project readers
findings.suggestedFix: Use the shared taipeiDate helper for projects.ts default arguments and remove the UTC fallback.

findings.title: Background scans can exit without a terminal finish attempt
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the entire post-start background cycle in one finally-owned terminal finish path with exactly-once guarding.

findings.title: Scheduler lease can expire during work and still report success
findings.suggestedFix: Renew or bound the lease during execution and conditionally finalize only while the owner still holds it.

findings.title: Confirming one Daily diary changes the global daily-log confirmation state
findings.suggestedFix: Keep project_daily_diaries confirmation independent from daily_logs.summary_status and legacy per_project_summary.

summary: Initial independent review rejected the Change. Desktop-only scope is accepted; mobile/RWD validation is not a finding.
